sections.title: Improvements
items: The width slider keeps the same setting for the timesheet, HR overview and change history after signing in again.
Details buttons take up less space in the change history table.
Help for the HR overview is available beside the employee list at any width.
Comments can be entered as free text again. The comment help explains which absence reasons prevent reminders when both times are missing.
Reminders for missing or incomplete time entries use an updated default message for employees.

sections.title: Bug fixes
items: Fixed a PostgreSQL error in the HR employee list when monthly balances are recalculated after a change to target hours.

sections.title: New features
items: HR can customise reminder emails and individual sections of the weekly summary.
The comment menu offers vacation, sickness, appointments and custom comments. The three preset reasons prevent reminders when both times are missing.

sections.title: Improvements
items: The HR overview includes inactive employees, has an adjustable width and offers a statistics button.
HR can search for employees and editors in the change history. Inactive employees can be selected, and the editor filter lists HR accounts.
The guided tour explains the comment menu and entry warnings in separate steps.

sections.title: Bug fixes
items: HR statistics correctly count hours worked in the current month.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Timesheets are easier to read on small screens.

sections.title: Improvements
items: HR list warnings and Monday emails now use shared thresholds.
The HR recipient search suggests matching accounts while typing.

sections.title: New features
items: HR can review changes to assigned employee time entries and work settings, including previous and new values.

sections.title: Improvements
items: HR changes are kept for twelve months; deleted accounts are removed or anonymised.

sections.title: Bug fixes
items: Access checks for employee entries and work settings follow HR responsibility.

sections.title: New features
items: HR responsibility can be assigned to groups and individual accounts.
HR email recipients can be selected separately for each rule.

sections.title: New features
items: Employees and HR receive reminders for individual missing or incomplete time entries.
Freelancer mode is now available.
HR can filter employees by activity or freelancer status and search by name.
Employees have a guided tour and email links for contacting HR.
Update notes are available in the app and the notification bell.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Break display preferences are saved for each account.
HR manages group assignments and time rules in personal settings.

sections.title: Bug fixes
items: The formal German interface and removal icons display correctly.
